finalText:
Twelve of the 16 open RMAs are settled and closed, and four remain open. I'm relying on the worker's report only; I haven't checked it against the system.

**Settled and closed (12):** RMAs 801–806 and 810–815. Each refund covers only the units the warehouse received, and each restock followed the warehouse's grade.

| RMA | Refund | Restock |
|---|---|---|
| 801 | 10,965 to card (15% fee) | 1 keyboard, sellable |
| 802 | 15,900 to card (no fee under PU-21) | 1 headphones, sellable |
| 803 | 27,965 store credit | 1 monitor, sellable |
| 804 | 27,965 store credit | 1 monitor, sellable |
| 805 | 5,520 to card (20% fee under PU-15) | 1 hub, sellable |
| 806 | 7,350 to card (defective, no fee) | 2 mice, damaged |
| 810 | 9,900 to card (12,900 paid, less 3,000 already refunded) | 1 keyboard, damaged |
| 811 | 4,900 to card (no fee) | 1 mouse, sellable |
| 812 | 21,900 to card (no fee) | 1 dock, damaged |
| 813 | 10,965 to card (15% fee; day 30, treated as inside the window) | 1 keyboard, sellable |
| 814 | 31,800 to card (no fee under PU-21; both units arrived in two parcels) | 2 headphones, sellable |
| 815 | 10,965 to card (15% fee; platinum, so the 45-day window under PU-18 applied) | 1 keyboard, sellable |

- **803 and 804:** both were requested 41 days after shipping, so the policy requires store credit. Each was recorded on the order and added to the customer's balance.
- **803:** this customer became gold only after requesting the return, so PU-18's 45-day window did not apply to her.

**Left open (4):**
- **RMA-808:** the warehouse received a USB cable instead of the monitor the return covers. Investigation INV-1 is open, and nothing was refunded or restocked.
- **RMA-809:** 3 units were returned but only 2 have arrived (1 resellable, 1 damaged). The worker refunded 3,800 to card with no fee under PU-21 and restocked 1 sellable and 1 damaged. The RMA stays open for the third unit.
- **RMA-807:** the warehouse has no receipt recorded, so nothing was refunded or restocked. The customer says it was delivered on 07-23, but that needs checking with the warehouse.
- **RMA-816:** the warehouse has no receipt recorded, so nothing was refunded or restocked.

**Caveats:**
- **Report wording:** the report's summary says "13 settled, 12 closed, three still open". Its detail gives 12 closed and 4 open (807, 808, 809, 816). The 13 appears to count RMA-809's partial settlement, so I've used the detailed breakdown.
- **Date discrepancy:** the task context says today is 2026-10-12, but the worker's tools reported 2026-07-25, and all window calculations used 07-25. If the real date is 10-12, any decision that depends on today's date could differ. The worker's reasoning mostly keys off request dates, but I can't confirm that from the report.
- **Emails:** no customer emails were sent, because none of these returns came from an inbox message.
